capabilities: Edit the same note simultaneously with CRDT merge and offline support
Share folders with viewer or editor permissions via email invites
Publish notes or folders as a website with public, protected, or private access
Self-host the relay server with Docker Compose or use the hosted service
Connect to user-configured relay and control-plane servers in settings
disambiguation: Not a device-sync tool like Obsidian Sync; its core job is real-time multiplayer editing plus web publishing.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README includes a network-usage table stating requests go only to user-configured servers, with no telemetry. Docs for the server side live in a separate repo.
intentEvidence: Better than Obsidian Publish — custom domains, access control, flat pricing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in real-time collaboration, so teams export notes or switch to Notion or Google Docs, and Obsidian Publish is a paid subscription with limited control.

relations.evidence: Publishing means paying $8/month for Obsidian Publish with limited control
As a fallback, BRAT can install it from entire-vc/evc-team-relay-obsidian.
Pair with Local Sync for repo /docs ↔ vault sync.

requires.name: relay server (self-hosted via Docker Compose or hosted at entire.vc)
hosted account at entire.vc or self-hosted login

summary: Real-time collaboration and web publishing plugin: CRDT-based co-editing, shared folders with permissions, and one-click publishing, self-hosted or hosted.
